rationale: Total cover of $2.6M (face plus in-force) against $52,000 income is roughly 50x, far above the 20x multiple for age 41-50. The manual refers a large face-to-income ratio to judgement; desk practice postpones such files for financial evidence rather than rating them. Medically the file would sit near Standard (treated blood pressure, mildly elevated enzymes with no alcohol history), but that is moot until the amount is justified.
